name: santafe-compras-monitor
title: Santa Fe Tenders Scraper & Monitor (Licitaciones Santa Fe)
description: Scrape and monitor every public tender of the Province of Santa Fe, Argentina (Gestiones de Compra): licitaciones, concursos, contrataciones directas of ministries and hospitals with buyer, budget, deadlines, rubros, expediente and pliego/circular/acta PDF links. Server-side filters, delta mode for new, status-changed and amended tenders.
